file_list_assertion: Intentional MG21-only subset: the one MG21 RAW is mapped exactly once to published archaeological sample 21. Deposited LC-MSMS_Sample_Key.txt also resolves the other accession RAW files: F10 is sample 48 (Sciuridae fur) and F11 is sample 49 (Felidae fur); those are outside this human-skin subset.
biological_evidence: Publication Table 3 identifies sample 21 from Bulhakovo kurgan 5 burial 2 as Homininae, probably Homo sapiens; PRIDE structured metadata lists Hominidae. Conservative family Hominidae is used for organism. The sample is archaeological leather made of skin; sex and age of the skin source are unknown.
technical_evidence: PRIDE sample preparation specifies trypsin digestion. PRIDE structured instrument and publication Methods specify Orbitrap Exploris 480; RAW name encodes DDA. The LC-MS/MS analysis uses aliquots of earlier ZooMS eluates.
limitations: This intentionally scoped human-origin skin subset covers one of three deposited RAW files. F10 and F11 are resolved by the deposited sample key but excluded because they are non-human fur specimens. The sample-21 taxon is Homininae (probably Homo sapiens) in the paper; family Hominidae is used conservatively, and species is not asserted.
